name: Starter Pack
displayDescription: The best way to start in ScootX! Includes 20,000 In-Store Credits (awarded once), the Ember Outline rider aura, and the Seeing Stars bail effect. Permanent cosmetics.

name: VIP+ Pack
displayDescription: One-time purchase. Includes 100,000 in-store credits awarded once, permanent VIP access, unlimited saved scooter setups, unlimited saved replay clips, 3,000 credits every 7 days with credits accumulating while away, a glowing VIP name tag, an animated purple crown on your name tag and leaderboard entry, the VIP badge, and an exclusive VIP Pack Roblox badge. Thank you for supporting ScootX! :)

name: 10 Saved Setups
displayDescription: Save up to 10 scooter setups and switch between them in the shop. One-time purchase. VIP includes unlimited saved setups.

name: VIP
displayDescription: Permanent VIP — one-time purchase. Includes unlimited saved scooter setups and 3,000 In-Store Credit every week. Weekly credits accumulate while you are away.

name: 10 Saved Replay Clips
displayDescription: Save up to 10 replay clips and watch them from any angle. One-time purchase. VIP includes unlimited saved clips.

name: Propeller Spinner
displayDescription: A six-panel rainbow cap with a propeller that spins slowly on its own. Wear it in your ScootX rider wardrobe (Hats tab).

name: 24K Golden Top Hat
displayDescription: The ultimate flex. A diamond-cut 24K gold top hat with a pearl band, a flawless diamond, rubies and wings, glittering sparkles and gold shards orbiting your head. Wear it in your ScootX rider wardrobe (Hats tab).

name: Polska Beanie
displayDescription: Jesteście niesamowici, Polska!! Macie najwięcej graczy! A white and red knit beanie with the White Eagle crest, POLSKA lettering and a red and white pom-pom. Wear it in your ScootX rider wardrobe (Hats tab).

name: Classic Fedora
displayDescription: Camel felt fedora with a pinched crown, brown band, bow and a red feather. Wear it in your ScootX rider wardrobe (Hats tab).

name: Afterdark Pack
displayDescription: Two matching ScootX cosmetics in one permanent pack: the orange-and-purple Afterdark Trail and Afterdark Streamers for your bar ends. Preview both together in the shop, then equip the full look with one button. Cosmetic only: no speed, score, or credit boost.

name: Bar Handstand
displayDescription: Permanent Bar Handstand emote for ScootX. Crouch, spring off the deck and press into a handstand on your handlebars, then keep cruising and steering upside down. Toggle it off whenever you like. Cosmetic only; no speed or score advantage.

name: Witch Hat
displayDescription: A crooked violet witch hat with a wavy brim.

name: Trick or Treat!
displayDescription: Unlock the Trick or Treat! animated deck finish in ScootX. Spooky ghosts, crooked trees and mischievous monsters drift across your deck with a warm Halloween glow and golden sparkles. A permanent colour option for every scooter deck.

name: Tie-Dye Explosion Animated Deck
displayDescription: A psychedelic swirl of color that never stops moving across your deck. Unlocks the Tie-Dye Explosion finish as a color option on every deck.

name: Nebula Animated Deck
displayDescription: A drifting deep-space nebula with twinkling stars that flows across your deck. Unlocks the Nebula finish as a color option on every deck.

name: Indy Flip
displayDescription: Unlock the Indy Flip emote in ScootX! Push your scooter out, take a running start, plant both feet, and frontflip back onto the deck. Works while riding. Permanent cosmetic emote; does not award trick or event points.

name: Rage Slam
displayDescription: Spin a full 360 to build momentum and slam your scooter into the ground, then try to snap the deck. It will not break. Cosmetic emote only.

name: Chairman
displayDescription: Permanent Chairman emote for ScootX. Sit on your scooter handlebars and cruise around, including steering while riding. Toggle it off whenever you like. Featured limited emote. Cosmetic only; no speed or score advantage.

name: Scooter Backflip
displayDescription: Permanent Scooter Backflip emote for ScootX. Your rider performs a quick backflip while the scooter stays level, then lands back on the deck. Works while rolling; activate again for another flip. Cosmetic only; no speed or score advantage.

name: Scooter Showoff
displayDescription: Permanent Scooter Showoff emote for ScootX. Carry your equipped scooter with one hand on the bars and one on the deck, and walk around until you toggle it off. Cosmetic only; no speed or score advantage.

name: Seeing Stars
displayDescription: Eat the floor in style: a cartoon poof and dizzy stars circling your head when you crash. Cosmetic only.

name: Shockwave Crack
displayDescription: Glowing cracks shoot out from your wheels when you land, then seal back up. Bigger drops crack further. Cosmetic only.

name: Dust Ring
displayDescription: A colorful dust ring rolls out from your wheels on every landing. Bigger drops, bigger rings. Cosmetic only.

name: Paper Lanterns
displayDescription: Glowing paper lanterns hang from your bar ends and sway as you ride. Cosmetic only.

name: Unlimited Replay Clips
displayDescription: Save as many ScootX replay clips as you like. Replay tools are free for everyone: watch the last 60 seconds, scrub the timeline, choose camera angles, and hide the HUD for clean footage. Unlimited saved clips are already included with ScootX VIP.

name: Unlimited Saved Setups
displayDescription: Unlock unlimited saved scooter setups in ScootX with one purchase. Keep a collection of custom builds and switch between them in the shop. Your first saved setup is free.
